REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, May 21, 2019 - 06:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk

a.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
* 2018 STATE OF THE CITY RECAP VIDEO PRESENTATION
* CERTIFICATES OF RECOGNITION FOR GANG AND DRUG FREE POSTER CONTEST
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Council Member or staff.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-i be approved.
a.

i.
Award an Agreement with Williams Pipeline Contractors, Inc., for the Construction of the Walnut Street Water Main Replacement and Street Rehabilitation Project
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that City Council:
1.
Award a Public Works Agreement to Williams Pipeline Contractors Inc., in the amount of $1,459,982.50 for the Construction of the Walnut Street Water Main Replacement and Street Rehabilitation Project.
2.
Approve a total budget of $1,678,979.88 (which includes a 15% contingency for unforeseen conditions) for the Agreement; and
3.
Authorize the City Manager to execute the Public Works Agreement.

SCHEDULED ITEMS-No Scheduled Items
PUBLIC HEARING
8.
PUBLIC HEARING – DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE RELATED TO USE AMENDMENTS WITHIN THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL ZONE
Presented by Alicia Velasco, Community & Economic Development Director
RECOMMENDED ACTION: It is recommended that City Council:
1)
After conducting a public hearing, the City Attorney reads the title to introduce first reading of an ordinance amending Sections 11-1.49.02 (Principal uses permitted),11-1.49.04 (Permitted uses by conditional use permit), and 11-1.49.05 (Prohibited Uses), of the Downtown Commercial (D-C) zone within the Lomita Municipal Code; and 2) Direct staff to schedule the second reading and adoption of said ordinance for the June 4, 2019, City Council meeting.
ORD NO. 801 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA AMENDING LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 11-1.49.02 (PRINCIPAL USES PERMITTED) 11-1.49.04 (PERMITTED USES BY CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT), AND 11-1.49.05 (PROHIBITED USES) OF THE DOWNTOWN COMMERCIAL (D-C) ZONE. INITIATED BY THE CITY OF LOMITA (First Reading)
Item #8
9.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting will be held on Tuesday, June 4, 2019, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting at the following locations: Lomita City Hall lobby and outside bulletin board, Lomita Parks and Recreation, and uploaded to the City of Lomita website http://www.lomita.com/cityhall/city_agendas/.
Date Posted: May 16, 2019
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
